# Session 1

## 1. From Demand to Design {.theory-slide}

::: {.theory-card}
### Main topics

- Service needs and technical requirements.
- Demand models and user density.
- Traffic estimation and quality-of-service targets.
- Network KPIs: capacity, latency, availability.
- Scenario types: urban, rural, industrial, mobility.
:::

## 1. From Demand to Design: Use Case {.use-case-slide}

::: {.use-case-card}
### Example prompt

Compare a dense urban district and a rural county.

### Expected student task

- Estimate demand profiles.
- Define measurable KPIs.
- Separate hard requirements from assumptions.
- Explain why the two scenarios need different design targets.
:::
